body.description: Mowlet: a small push lawn mower creature, red deck body with a grass-stained skirt, the handle bar arching up like a tail, front wheels as paws, little blades whirring underneath, headlamp eyes, grass clippings flying. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
